name: blur
lore:
### Arcane Compendium: *Blur*

To the observer, a wizard wreathed in *Blur* becomes a smear of motion, a mirage dancing atop sun-baked stone. Their silhouette frays at the edges, bleeding into the air until reality itself loses focus. One does not simply see the caster; one sees where they *were* a heartbeat ago, a rhythmic oscillation of translucent afterimages.

Shaping this spell requires a "loose" touch upon the Weave. Unlike the rigid geometry of a *Shield*, *Blur* feels like silk sliding through the fingers or grasping at smoke. It is a deliberate unraveling of one’s physical definition, a greasing of the threads of fate so that blades simply fail to catch.

**The Legend of Vaelin’s Escape**
Scholarship credits the spell’s discovery to Master Vaelin the Unseen. Trapped by elven archers within a hall of mirrors, Vaelin did not conjure steel. Instead, he whispered to the reflections. As a hundred shafts took flight, they whistled through empty air, striking only the ghost-light of his wake. Vaelin walked through the volley unscathed—a smudge of indigo ink upon the parchment of the world.

*Note: Keep moving. The magic thrives on momentum; to stand still is to invite the eye to find the truth.*
